title: Head Dimension Matters in Language Models for Long-Context Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.32213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representation space. In long-context processing, it remains unclear whether allocating a fixed parameter budget to fewer, wider heads improves information retrieval. In this paper, we investigate how head dimension affects the performance of long-context retrieval tasks. Our empirical studies reveal that pretraining loss and short-context non-retrieval task performance are not affected much by head dimension, while long-context retrieval performance improves with wider heads at fixed model sizes. We find that models with wider heads have a higher proportion of retrieval heads, associating more parameters with retrieval. Our ablation studies also show that the retrieval performance improves with wider heads even when the projection weights in attention modules are froze

translated_title: 头维度对语言模型长上下文检索至关重要
translated_abstract: 多头注意力通过查询-键交互和值聚合来检索与组合上下文表示，其中头维度限制了每个注意力头的表示空间。在长上下文处理中，将固定的参数预算分配给更少但更宽的头是否能改善信息检索，目前仍不清楚。在本文中，我们研究了头维度如何影响长上下文检索任务的性能。我们的实证研究表明，头维度对预训练损失和短上下文非检索任务的性能影响不大，而在固定模型规模下，长上下文检索性能会随着头的变宽而提升。我们发现，拥有更宽头的模型具有更高比例的检索头，即有更多参数与检索功能相关联。我们的消融实验还表明，即使冻结注意力模块中的投影权重，检索性能仍会随头变宽而提升。
tldr: 本研究发现在固定模型规模下，增大注意力头维度可通过提高检索头的比例显著提升语言模型的长上下文检索性能，且即使冻结注意力投影权重该结论依然成立，而头维度对预训练损失和短上下文任务性能影响甚微。
en_tdlr: Wider attention head dimensions improve long-context retrieval in language models by increasing the proportion of retrieval heads—even with frozen attention projection weights—while barely affecting pretraining loss and short-context task performance.
